captions.detailed: An Alpine-style wooden bell cote featuring a narrow, dark brown rectangular timber frame with a gabled, pointed roof. Inside the upper frame, a single brass-colored bell hangs from a horizontal black pivot beam. The bell is mounted via a revolute joint, allowing it to swing back and forth around the horizontal headstock axis.
captions.instruction: Generate an Alpine wooden bell cote with a dark brown timber frame, a pointed gabled roof, and a brass bell suspended inside. The bell should be attached via a revolute joint to a horizontal headstock beam, allowing it to swing about the horizontal axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using box primitives for the vertical posts, horizontal base, and top crossbeams, colored in dark brown. Create the pointed roof using two angled box shapes configured as a gable. Model the bell headstock as a small black box, and the bell itself using a combination of a cylinder and a lofted/revolved bell shape. Define a revolute articulation (joint) connecting the bell assembly to the frame along the horizontal pitch axis.
